design: End keyframe of R6_A8 and the last picture of SEQ_029: the whole bedroom at deep night, Maria asleep with her hand on MACA's chest, MACA seated perfectly still, Chico curled across Maria's feet ON THE BED, the same cream knit blanket as the previous shots. prompt: Edit image 1, the wide night view of Maria's bedroom. Keep its room, deep night lighting, camera position and lens, the window with its tall curtains and starry sky, the half-open door with warm light beyond it, the dresser at the right edge, the dark wood floor, the oval rug, the bed under the window at the left and the star toy chest at the foot of the bed exactly as they are. Change only the people and the dog so the frame shows the end of the night: Maria lies on her side in the bed, deeply asleep, her cheek resting against MACA's chest and her small hand flat on the middle of MACA's chest panel, the cream chunky knit blanket pulled up over her; she wears her pink pyjamas with the light-blue collar. MACA sits upright and perfectly still on the floor beside the bed, close to Maria, her blue face screen calm with two small smiling eyes and her chest panel glowing low and warm under Maria's hand, the only warm light in the room. Chico, the small tan-and-white chihuahua with the pink collar, is curled up asleep ON TOP OF THE BLANKET across Maria's feet at the foot of the bed, next to the toy chest; he is not on the floor and not on the rug. Exactly one Maria, one MACA and one Chico, nobody else, no second dog anywhere. The blanket is the same cream chunky knit blanket shown in image 3, never a blue blanket, never a cloud print, never a patterned quilt. Do not add stars on the walls, a rocket picture, a spindle footboard, a white door or any toys. MACA's helmet stays a clean, smooth, round white shell with one round ear disc on each side and nothing attached to it: no fins, no wings, no rays, no lines, no spikes, no antennae, no fan blades, no sparks and no steam near her head or ears. Image 2 shows Maria's pose leaning against MACA's glowing chest panel, her pink pyjamas and MACA's chest panel, as a close-up for pose and outfit only; do not copy its framing or its room. Image 3 shows the cream knit blanket and Chico, for those two things only. Image 5 is a layout reference only (bed under the window at the left, door at the right, toy chest at the foot of the bed, oval rug); never take its warm colours, its tile floor, its wall colour or its blanket. Image 1 is the authority for render style, lens, lighting, room, furniture and colour: keep its finished 3D animated film look exactly, as if this were another frame of the same shot. Image 4 is a painted character sheet used only for identity (faces, hair, wardrobe colours); never copy its painted style, its plain background or its poses. Identity, from the identity board image: Maria is a small girl with black bangs, a thin yellow headband, a side ponytail with a pink scrunchie, and at night pink pyjamas with a light-blue collar. MACA is a tall female robot with a white riveted helmet, a glowing blue face screen with two smiling eyes, a pink chest plate with a small dark inset screen and an orange hip plate. Chico is a small tan-and-white chihuahua with a pink collar. One instance of each character only. Output one 16:9 full-colour production frame, 1280x720, no text, no sketch lines.
